messages:
maria: Velociti pushed back the RFI. They want: capability CSV, completed security questionnaire, HSM diagram, and a short pricing worked example by EOD Friday.
omar: Exceptions they flagged: 1) customer HSM for Private, 2) FedRAMP status for Dedicated, 3) how caching affects token billing.
jess: Paste customer Qs so we can map answers: 
> Q-HSM: Can we bring our own HSM into Private?
> Q-FedRAMP: Is any Redwood offering FedRAMP authorized?
> Q-Billing: Explain prefix/KV cache billing impact and per-token vs per-request.
liam: Quick facts to draft: Private supports customer HSM appliances + cloud KMS; Dedicated supports cloud KMS integrations; hosted multitenant does not accept customer HSM hardware. Not FedRAMP as of 2026-03-20. Hosted billing: per-token; Dedicated: committed capacity + overage per-token. Caching typically reduces billed tokens by ~25-40% for chat.
security: I'll assemble questionnaire responses and attach vendor list (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS, Thales Luna, Utimaco) and mark validated ones for Private.
jess: I'll generate capability_matrix.csv with columns: capability,hosted,dedicated,private,notes. CSV snippet uploaded here: https://drive.google.com/example-capmatrix (internal).
maria: Liam please put placeholder numbers in pricing_estimate.xlsx we can sanitize later. Example line to include: 4xA100 reserved = $26,000/month baseline; cache hit rate 35% -> effective billed tokens reduce accordingly; Dedicated overage = $0.55/1k tokens; Hosted gen = $0.03/1k tokens. Mark as estimates.
liam: Done, uploaded: https://drive.google.com/example-pricing (internal). Marked as "internal use only".
omar: Draft RFI reply text (will be attached to bundle): "Thanks Velociti. Attached: capability matrix and completed security questionnaire. Short answers to exceptions: (1) HSM - Private supports customer HSM appliances and cloud KMS integrations; Dedicated supports cloud KMS integrations; Hosted multitenant does not host customer HSM hardware. (2) FedRAMP - Redwood is not FedRAMP-authorized as of 2026-03-20; we maintain a compliance roadmap and offer partner-assisted hosting for regulated workloads. (3) Billing/caching - see attached pricing_estimate.xlsx; prefix/KV caching reduces billed token volume depending on hit rate; working example included."
jess: Add a line offering a 60-min architecture review with our infra/SRE to validate HSM approach and run a quick PoC probe.
ops-bot: Reminder created: Velociti RFI bundle due 2026-03-26 17:00 PT. Attachments required: capability_matrix.csv, security_questionnaire_filled.pdf, hsm_diagram.png, pricing_estimate.xlsx. Notifying @ae-beth.
ae-beth: I'll review the bundle by Thursday afternoon and sign-off if all looks correct. Ping me once uploaded.
maria: Plan: jess (capmatrix + diagram), security (questionnaire + vendor table), liam (pricing), omar (final text + upload). Target upload by Thu 16:30 PT.
security: I'll deliver questionnaire by Thu 15:00 PT.
liam: Pricing final by Thu 12:00 PT.
jess: CSV and PNG uploaded. Link: https://drive.google.com/example-capmatrix-and-diagram (internal).
maria: Thanks team. Once AE signs off we'll send the formal reply.
ops-bot: Ticket RFI-5987 updated: owner @maria, due 2026-03-26 17:00 PT.
